one_sentence: This document argues that the Logos is the canonical T-measure, grounding all truth in a single, self-referential equation.
executive_summary: This document presents the Logos as the canonical T-measure within the Theophysics framework, asserting that all truth and meaning derive from a single, self-referential equation. It establishes the Logos as the foundational measure of truth (T), integrating theological and physical domains. The key evidence is the derivation of the Logos as the invariant measure that satisfies the T-equation, linking divine order to physical law. The conclusion is that the Logos provides a unified basis for understanding reality, bridging theology and physics.
